chapters.title: Getting Started
text: Barely Functional Contraptions makes power from mushrooms, light and empty space, and grows resources on sheep.
## The machine casing
Every machine is built around a Functional Machine Block: craft it from iron ingots, copper ingots and redstone, and use it in the machine recipes.
## The loop
- Mycelial Generators burn mushrooms and water to make Forge Energy (FE).
- Feed sheep a resource (an iron ingot, a diamond...) to infuse their wool.
- Shear them for resource wool, and turn the wool back into resources in a Mechanical Separator powered by FE.
- Mushroom sheep give the generators their fuel, which closes the loop.
Sneak and right-click a sheep with an empty hand to see what it is infused with. JEI and Jade, if installed, show recipes and machine details.

chapters.title: Mycelial Generator
text: Burns red or brown mushrooms and water to make FE: 200 FE/t from brown mushrooms, 250 FE/t from red ones.
## Running it
- Give it water with a bucket, a bucket in its slot, a pipe, or a Fluid Reservoir placed next to it.
- Put mushrooms in the top slot. Hoppers and pipes can insert from any side.
- It pushes energy into cables and machines next to it.
## Networks
Generators that touch form a network, and every running member boosts the whole network's output exponentially.
## Mycelium
Running generators slowly turn nearby dirt into mycelium and sometimes sprout huge mushrooms, which gives you more fuel.

chapters.title: Wrench and Links
text: The Barely Functional Wrench links blocks without touching.
- Right-click a generator, then another generator, to link them into one network (up to 64 blocks apart).
- Right-click a generator, then a Mechanical Separator, Automatic Shears or Hume Energy Cube, to power it wirelessly.
- Sneak and right-click a block to remove its links. Sneak and right-click the air to clear your selection.
The generator's screen shows how it is connected and which machines it is powering.
The wrench also sets each side of a Fluid or Item Pipe: see Pipe Sides.

chapters.title: Infusing Sheep
text: Right-click a grown sheep holding a resource, such as an Iron Ingot, a Diamond or a Red Mushroom.
- Its fleece takes the resource's colour, and small blocks of the resource grow out of it.
- Each infusion lasts 100 shearings by default.
- Breed infused sheep with wheat and the lamb is born infused too.
- Kill an infused sheep with its wool for a little extra.
Anything that isn't a resource works as normal, so wheat, dyes and shears behave as usual.
## More resources
Data packs can add any resource, and operators can run /barelyfunctionalcontraptions generate to make one for every metal in the modpack.

chapters.title: Wool and Machines
text: ## Mechanical Separator
Put resource wool in and supply FE. Each wool gives 2 to 4 of its resource, 2 string and sometimes a bonus. Iron wool takes 20,000 FE over 5 seconds.
Its redstone button sets whether redstone turns it on or off. Hoppers and pipes can feed it and empty it.
## Automatic Shears
Shears every sheep in the 3x3 area in front of its blades, using 2,000 FE per sheep, and keeps the wool in 9 slots. Put a hopper or pipe under it to collect the wool.

chapters.title: Themed Sheep
text: Ten resources turn sheep into little versions of the mob they come from:
- Hay Bale: a hay fleece (wheat).
- Nether Star: two Wither Skeleton Skulls beside its head (nether stars).
- Dragon's Breath: dragon wings (dragon's breath).
- Glow Ink Sac: a glowing fleece that lights up the ground (glow ink).
- Bone Block and Wither Rose: skull faces and bony legs (bones).
- Spider Eye: extra legs and red eyes (spider eyes).
- Echo Shard: sculk tendrils (echo shards).
- Blaze Rod: always on fire, but never hurt (blaze rods).
- Ghast Tear: twice the size, tentacles, and it screams like a ghast (ghast tears).
Each one has its own advancement, and collecting every wool is a challenge.

chapters.title: Water and Fluids
text: ## Fluid Reservoir
Place it on top of an infinite water source and it fills with a bucket of water a second, which it pushes into tanks and generators beside it.
## Fluid Tank
Holds 16 buckets of one fluid. Touching tanks join into one big tank that fills from the bottom up. Use buckets on it, or connect pipes on any side.
## Fluid Pipe
Carries fluid between anything that holds it, up to 4 buckets a tick. Machines are filled first, then tanks.

chapters.title: Energy
text: ## Hume Energy Cube
A battery: 1,000,000 FE and 10,000 FE/t per cube. Touching cubes join into one bigger battery that pushes into the machines and cables around it.
## Energy Cable
Joins generators, batteries and machines into one network moving up to 100,000 FE/t. Generators power machines first and charge cubes with the rest.
## Energy Meter

Place it between a generator or battery and what it powers: it works out which way the energy flows by itself (in at the back, out at the front). The wrench flips it. Its screens show the FE/t passing through. Right-click for the total, and read it with a comparator: the signal rises with the flow.

chapters.title: Zero Point Module
text: Place two modules facing each other, on a floor and ceiling or on two walls, with open space between them.
- They link with a beam and make 1,000 FE/t for every block of gap, up to 64 blocks.
- Take the energy from either end.
- Stained glass in the gap colours the beam.
- The beam burns anything that walks into it, and mobs it kills drop loot as if you had killed them.

chapters.title: Glow Panels
text: The Glow Panel makes power from the light falling on its top.
- In full sunlight it makes 60 FE/t, less at dawn, dusk and in rain, and nothing at night.
- Under block light it makes up to 40 FE/t. A Glow Lamp on it or above it gives the full amount, day or night, even underground.
- A glowing Glow Ink sheep standing next to it lights it up too.
It pushes its energy into blocks beside and below it.
## Glow Lamp
A full-brightness lamp made from glow ink sacs, glass and glowstone dust.

chapters.title: Blaze Furnace
text: The Blaze Sheep Furnace makes power from the heat of Blaze sheep standing in the 5x5 area around it (the config's radius), on its own level or on top of it.
- One Blaze sheep gives 80 FE/t. Each extra one adds a little less: 150, 210 and 260 FE/t for two, three and four. It counts up to four.
- Only a sheep showing its blazing fleece counts. A sheared sheep or a lamb gives nothing until its wool grows back.
- In rain or water a sheep gives half.
- Right-click with a Blaze Rod to load it, or put rods in the boost slot in its window: each rod doubles the output for 30 seconds. Hoppers and pipes can fill it too.
Shear the sheep for Blaze Rods, or leave the fleece on for power: that's the trade-off.
It pushes its energy into every block around it, and a comparator reads one level per 20 FE/t.
Right-click it with an empty hand to open its window. The fire in the middle column rises with the heat; each line is one more heat source, and its pip lights while that source is in use.
## Showing the area
Click the spyglass button in the furnace's or the Automatic Shears' window, or sneak-right-click either block with an empty hand, to show or hide its working area.

chapters.title: Wool Burner
text: The Wool Burner burns spare wool for power, one item at a time.
- Plain wool (any colour): 30 FE/t for 10 seconds.
- String: 30 FE/t for 2.5 seconds.
- Coal Wool: 120 FE/t for 20 seconds.
Right-click it with fuel to load it, put fuel in the slot in its window, or feed it with a hopper or pipe. Hoppers and pipes can't take fuel back out.
It stores 20,000 FE and pushes it into every block around it. While its buffer is full it waits before lighting the next item, so nothing is wasted.
A comparator reads how full its fuel slot is.
## Data packs
Fuels are data: data/<namespace>/barelyfunctionalcontraptions/wool_burner_fuel/<name>.json, each with an ingredient, a burn_time in ticks and a power in FE/t.

chapters.title: Pipe Sides
text: Each side where a Fluid or Item Pipe meets a block can be set up on its own with the Barely Functional Wrench.
## Modes
Right-click the plug with the wrench to cycle it:
- Normal: fills the block, and only takes from pure sources such as the Automatic Shears.
- Pull (orange): empties the block, chests and tanks included.
- Push (green): only fills the block, never takes from it.
- Off: no connection. Wrench the face of the pipe's core to turn it back on.
## Filters

Sneak and right-click the plug with the wrench to open its filter: a 3x3 grid. Click a slot holding an item, or a bucket of a fluid, to filter it there; click with nothing to remove it. Only filtered things pass that side. The grid also has a mode button and a Clear button.
Shortcut: hold an item in your other hand and right-click the plug with the wrench to add it to the filter, or remove it again.

chapters.title: Data Packs
text: Sheep resources are data: data/<namespace>/barelyfunctionalcontraptions/sheep_resources/<name>.json. They reload with /reload.
An appearance block gives any resource wings, extra heads, glowing, a bigger size, its own sounds and more.

Furnace heat sources are data too: data/<namespace>/barelyfunctionalcontraptions/furnace_heat/<name>.json names a sheep, an entity or a look such as on_fire, and its power. Boost items are the blaze_furnace_boost data map.
## Commands
- /barelyfunctionalcontraptions list: every loaded resource.
- /barelyfunctionalcontraptions generate: a resource for every material in the modpack.
- /barelyfunctionalcontraptions generate item <item>: a resource fed with any item.
Every number in the mod can be changed in its config files, from the mod list's Config button.
